label: Flat Screen UI
mood: a flat, generic user-interface mock-up as the picture — overlapping desktop windows with plain title bars, a message thread, a music-player card or a search field with its suggestion list, drawn as plain rounded rectangles in a few palette inks with a hairline outline and a hard offset shadow, like a contemporary editorial illustration of a screen. The copy itself is on the screen: the headline typed into the search field or sent as a message, the date in a dialog, the time at the end of the progress bar. Good for tech talks, launches and online events, hackathons, music nights and festivals, youth and campus programmes, webinars and sign-up calls.

shadow.note: hard (a flat offset shadow in the ink, printed as vector) | soft (a blurred drop shadow) | none

outline.note: weight of the hairline around windows and controls: 0 = none … 1 = normal … 2 = heavy

radius.note: corner rounding of windows, bubbles and buttons: 0 = square … 1 = normal … 2 = very round

windows.note: two or three overlapping desktop windows with plain title bars — flat abstract shapes in one, a dialog with the event date set large and an OK button, a short list with a progress bar — and an arrow cursor on top

chat.note: a message thread whose bubbles are the copy, verbatim: the headline, the date, the place, then the call to action (or a typing bubble)

player.note: a music-player card: a square cover of flat shapes, the headline as the track title, the eyebrow as the artist, a progress bar ending at the event time, and play controls

search.note: a search field with the headline typed in it and a text cursor, and below it a suggestion list made from the information rows
